about: GTA 6 day one retail sales reached $3.79 billion (Take-Two/Rockstar press release Nov 20 2026: 'day one retail sales* reached $3.79 billion, setting a new record for entertainment across any medium, and becoming the biggest entertainment launch in history'; '*based on company estimates through end of day November 19th worldwide'). Comparison, same company and same measure: GTA V 'achieved first day sell-through of more than $800 million worldwide, excluding the upcoming launch in Japan and Brazil, according to Company estimates' (Take-Two, Sept 18 2013, SEC 8-K Ex 99.1), and 'worldwide retail sales of more than $1 billion during its first three days on sale' (Take-Two, Sept 20 2013, SEC 8-K Ex 99.1). Nominal dollars, not adjusted for inflation. All read 2026-11-21. Sources in BRIEF.md.
